products.name: Commercial Truck Comprehensive
products.description: Comprehensive commercial motor cover for rigid trucks, tractor units, tippers, and tankers. Includes own damage, statutory and excess third-party liability, driver PA, goods in transit, theft/hijack, and optional trailer, breakdown, and loading/overturning extensions. GVW up to 49t. Tracker required for full theft and GIT limits.

PRD-011::2026.05-DRAFT::covers.name: Personal Accident

PRD-015::2026.08::covers.name: Own Damage — Truck & Chassis
PRD-015::2026.08::covers.description: Covers accidental damage, fire, explosion, and natural peril loss to the insured truck, chassis, and permanently fitted equipment.

constraints.value: Rigid, Tractor Unit, Tipper, Tanker, Box, Flatbed

PRD-015::2026.08::covers.wordingDoc: Commercial Truck Policy Wording — Own Damage clause

PRD-015::2026.08::covers.name: Third Party Liability
PRD-015::2026.08::covers.description: Statutory and excess third-party liability for death, bodily injury, and property damage arising from commercial truck use.

PRD-015::2026.08::covers.name: Driver & Cleaner Personal Accident
PRD-015::2026.08::covers.description: Fixed benefit for accidental death or permanent disability of the named driver and cleaner while on duty.

PRD-015::2026.08::covers.name: Goods in Transit
PRD-015::2026.08::covers.description: Covers loss or damage to lawful cargo carried on the insured truck, including loading and unloading at declared locations.

PRD-015::2026.08::covers.name: Trailer & Semi-Trailer
PRD-015::2026.08::covers.description: Extends own-damage and theft cover to declared trailers and semi-trailers attached to the insured tractor unit.

PRD-015::2026.08::covers.name: Theft & Hijack
PRD-015::2026.08::covers.description: Covers theft of the truck, trailer, or cargo following forcible entry, hijack, or armed robbery while in transit.

PRD-015::2026.08::covers.name: Breakdown & Recovery
PRD-015::2026.08::covers.description: 24/7 commercial recovery, towing to nearest authorised workshop, and roadside mechanical assistance. Up to 6 call-outs per year.

PRD-015::2026.08::covers.name: Loading, Unloading & Overturning
PRD-015::2026.08::covers.description: Covers damage to the truck, trailer, or cargo caused by loading, unloading, tipping, or overturning during commercial operations.

derived.usedIn: Rating factors (driver age band), Eligibility rules (minimum age 25)

questions.label: Night Operations?
questions.helpText: Night haul and tankers may be referred.

PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.name: Min Driver Age — Commercial
PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.description: Named driver must be at least 25 years old for commercial truck cover.
PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.customerMsg: Commercial truck cover is only available to drivers aged 25 and over.

PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.name: Valid HGV / CMV Licence
PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.description: Primary driver must hold a valid heavy goods or commercial motor vehicle licence.
PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.customerMsg: A valid heavy vehicle licence is required for this product.
PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.internalMsg: Licence class not in HGV/CMV allowlist.

PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.name: Max Vehicle Age
PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.description: Truck must be 20 years old or newer.
PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.customerMsg: This product is only available for trucks manufactured within the last 20 years.

PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.name: GVW Cap
PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.description: Gross vehicle weight must not exceed 49 tonnes.
PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.customerMsg: Vehicles above 49 tonnes require a specialist fleet product.

PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.name: Min HGV Experience
PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.description: Primary driver must have at least 2 years of heavy-vehicle experience.
PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.customerMsg: Drivers with under 2 years of HGV experience may receive a premium loading.

PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.name: Hazardous Goods Refer
PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.description: Class 1 explosives and radioactive cargo are referred to specialist underwriting.
PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.customerMsg: Hazardous cargo of this class needs a specialist review before we can quote.

PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.name: Tracking Device for Theft Cover
PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.description: Theft & Hijack requires an active GPS tracking device.
PRD-015::2026.08::eligibilityRules.customerMsg: Theft cover can be added once an approved tracking device is fitted.

PRD-015::2026.08::ratingComponents.name: Base Rate — Commercial Truck
PRD-015::2026.08::ratingComponents.notes: Commercial motor base rate validated 12-Aug-2026 against 2025 heavy-vehicle loss ratios.

PRD-015::2026.08::ratingComponents.name: Goods Class Factor
PRD-015::2026.08::ratingComponents.bands: General merchandise ×1.00 · Perishable / refrigerated ×1.15 · Construction materials ×1.10 · Fuel / flammable liquids ×1.45 · Chemicals (non-explosive) ×1.35

PRD-015::2026.08::ratingComponents.name: Payable premium formula
PRD-015::2026.08::ratingComponents.expression: Base Premium × Risk Factors + Loadings − Discounts + Add-ons + Fees + Taxes = Payable Premium

PRD-015::2026.08::underwritingRules.name: Require inspection for high SI
PRD-015::2026.08::underwritingRules.description: Request physical inspection and tracker certificate before bind.

PRD-015::2026.08::underwritingRules.name: Standard commercial accept
PRD-015::2026.08::underwritingRules.description: Accept if no decline, refer, load, or restrict rule has fired.

PRD-015::2026.08::channels.name: Commercial Broker Portal
PRD-015::2026.08::channels.description: Appointed commercial motor brokers. Bind up to $200k OD SI.
